caseName: Water, Light & Gas Co. v. City of Hutchinson
caseNameFull: WATER, LIGHT & GAS COMPANY v. CITY OF HUTCHINSON, KANSAS
syllabus: Water, Light & Gas Co. v. Hutchinson, 207 U. S. 385, in which it was held that an exclusive franchise cannot, under the statutes of Kansas, be granted by ordinance by a city of the second class, followed.
summary: APPEAL FROM THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE DISTRICT OF KANSAS.
attorneys: Mr. Howard S. Lewis, Mr. H. Whiteside, Mr. John F. Dillon, Mr. Harry Hubbard and Mr. Frank Dosier for appellant., Mr. Max Pam and Mr. A. C. Mallory for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Affirmed with costs, on authority of Water, Light & Gas Co. of Hutchinson v. The City of Hutchinson, 207 U. S. 385.
